sources.quality_notes: Public Commons scan of NLC item NLC416-12jh005266-45094, 221 PDF pages versus catalog [218] book pages, catalog holding MG/B992.3. Original PDF browser page p0 title, p1-p4 prefaces, p5-p7 categorized casebook contents and p219 imprint visually reviewed. On p4 Zhang Yipan author preface dated 1934-09-01 says 上海命學社; p219 identifies 民國二十三年十月出版, 編著者張一蟠, 發行者命學社. This original internal imprint proves a 1934 book's stated Shanghai society publisher, NOT that the 1927 新命 modern reprint's 命學苑/宛 is the same institution or that a 1927 original was inspected. Original PDF binary SHA256 and page hashes unavailable; no glyph-perfect authority, no full-book collation, no exact physical-copy impression claim, no direct textual transmission or chart runtime claim.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1934《定命錄》內文「上海命學社」及刊記「發行者命學社」不能自動等於2018出版宣傳所稱1927《新命》「命學苑／宛」同一組織
1924《人鑑》—1927《新命》—1934《定命錄》非已證實的作品直傳或法人連續鏈
unresolved_lineage_questions: 1927《新命》原刊卷首、〈本苑創立宣言〉、刊記原字與館藏實物
1927《新命》「命學苑／宛」與1934《定命錄》「命學社」間是否存在有原始史料支撐的組織同一／改名／師承關係
